name: ntfy
description: Simple HTTP-based pub-sub notification service. Send push notifications to your phone or desktop via scripts.
summary: ntfy v2.26.3 (released 2026-07-20) is the latest release, adding an abuse ban-feed feature (`ban-file`) that tracks abusive IPs and writes them to a file for fail2ban integration. v2.26.0 patched a CPU denial-of-service vulnerability in message templates and added configurable date/time formats in the web app. Recent releases (v2.24.0–v2.25.0) also fixed a critical case-insensitive ACL bypass on SQLite, added password reset via email magic links, an in-memory ACL cache for high-volume servers, and multiple web app improvements. See release notes at https://github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy/releases.

answers.What is the current license?: Apache 2.0 (server) and GPL (client portions); dual-licensed — check repo for details
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases in 2026 with active bug fixes, security patches, and new features
answers.Does it support authentication and acces: Yes — user accounts, access control lists (ACL), token-based auth, and an optional in-memory ACL cache
answers.Is there a hosted cloud version availabl: Yes — ntfy.sh is the official hosted instance

breaking_excerpts: Fix case-insensitive ACL topic matching on SQLite: an access control rule for 'secret' no longer also matches a request for 'SECRET' — behavior change that may affect existing ACL rules on SQLite deployments.
Email verification reworked from in-memory 6-digit codes to durable magic links; old verification flows are replaced.
X-Email: yes now requires being logged in with a verified primary email regardless of smtp-sender-verify setting — previously it was accepted without verification.

alternatives.name: Pushover
alternatives.review: Paid SaaS, simple API, iOS/Android apps.

alternatives.name: Gotify
alternatives.review: Self-hosted only, real-time push via WebSocket.

alternatives.name: Apprise
alternatives.review: Apprise is a versatile notification library supporting dozens of services but is a code/CLI library rather than a standalone pub-sub server like ntfy.

alternatives.name: Pushbullet
alternatives.review: Pushbullet provides easy device-to-device notifications and file sharing but is a proprietary cloud service with a limited free tier and no self-hosting unlike ntfy.

alternatives.name: Synapse / Matrix
alternatives.review: Matrix/Synapse is a fully self-hosted, open-source, federated messaging platform that supports notifications but is significantly more complex to set up and operate than ntfy.
